panels.description: New Plant inflow meter (no outflow meter in use). Latest reading day, % of design (1,800 m³/day) and 30-day average.

targets.rawSql:
WITH fl AS (SELECT (d.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day, sum(CASE WHEN d.is_override THEN d.reset_value ELSE d.daily_flow END) AS v FROM user_flowmeterreadingdata d JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = d.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 12 AND f.is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(f.title_override,''), f.name) ILIKE 'Flow Meter (In - New Plant)%' AND d.datetime > now() - interval '31 days' AND d.datetime < now() GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN d.is_override THEN d.reset_value ELSE d.daily_flow END) BETWEEN 0 AND 9000),
pw AS (SELECT (d.datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day, sum(CASE WHEN d.is_override THEN d.reset_value ELSE d.daily_power END) AS v FROM user_powermeterreadingdata d JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = d.form_id WHERE f.team_id = 12 AND f.is_enabled AND COALESCE(NULLIF(f.title_override,''), f.name) ILIKE 'Power Meter - %STP%' AND d.datetime > now() - interval '31 days' AND d.datetime < now() GROUP BY 1) SELECT (SELECT v FROM fl ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Latest day", (SELECT v FROM fl ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1) / 18 AS "% of design", avg(v) AS "⌀ 30 days" FROM fl

panels.title: Residual chlorine · latest

panels.description: Daily lab results for the selected period. Limits from the existing Nafal dashboards. Nitrate in mg/L, limit 50. SV30 from the aeration tank. Latest and days outside are coloured by the limit: green within, amber/red outside, purple impossible value.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (WITH lim(param, test, ord, unit, dec, warn, alarm, lo, hi, sev, limtxt) AS (VALUES
('Ammonia nitrogen','Ammonia Nitrogen',1,'mg/L',1,5,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber','< 5'),
('Residual chlorine','Free and Residual Chlorine',2,'mg/L',2,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,0.1,0.5,'amber','0.1 – 0.5'),
('Nitrate','Nitrate Nitrogen',3,'mg/L',1,50,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber','< 50'),
('pH','pH',4,'',1,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,6.5,8,'amber-excl','6.5 – 8'),
('SV30 · aeration tank','SV30',5,'mL/L',0,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,400,600,'amber','400 – 600')),
d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Aeration%' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume' THEN 'SV30' ELSE btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) END AS test, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v
 FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id
 WHERE f.team_id = 12 AND (btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Treated Wastewater' OR (btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Aeration%' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT lim.param, lim.ord, lim.unit, lim.dec, lim.warn, lim.alarm, lim.lo, lim.hi, lim.sev, lim.limtxt, to_char(d.day,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, d.v FROM lim LEFT JOIN d ON d.test = lim.test ORDER BY lim.ord, d.day),
v AS (SELECT param, ord, unit, dec, warn, alarm, lo, hi, sev, limtxt, day, v, (v < 0 OR (param ~* '\mph\M' AND v > 14)) AS bad FROM x),
p AS (SELECT param, min(ord) AS ord, max(unit) AS unit, max(dec) AS dec, max(warn) AS warn, max(alarm) AS alarm, max(lo) AS lo, max(hi) AS hi, max(sev) AS sev, max(limtxt) AS limtxt,
  avg(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS av, min(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS mn, max(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS mx, count(v) FILTER (WHERE NOT bad) AS n, count(v) FILTER (WHERE bad) AS nbad,
  (array_agg(v ORDER BY day DESC) FILTER (WHERE v IS NOT NULL))[1] AS latest FROM v GROUP BY param),
q AS (SELECT p.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM v WHERE v.param = p.param AND NOT v.bad AND ((p.lo IS NOT NULL AND (v.v < p.lo OR (CASE WHEN p.sev LIKE '%excl' THEN v.v >= p.hi ELSE v.v > p.hi END))) OR (p.lo IS NULL AND p.warn IS NOT NULL AND v.v >= p.warn))) AS nout FROM p)
SELECT param || CASE WHEN unit <> '' THEN ' (' || unit || ')' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN nbad > 0 THEN ' · ' || nbad || ' impossible|purple' ELSE '' END AS "Parameter",
 CASE WHEN latest IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE round(latest::numeric, dec)::text ||
  CASE WHEN latest < 0 OR (param ~* '\mph\M' AND latest > 14) THEN '|purple'
       WHEN lo IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN latest < lo OR (CASE WHEN sev LIKE '%excl' THEN latest >= hi ELSE latest > hi END) THEN '|' || CASE WHEN sev LIKE 'red%' THEN 'red' ELSE 'amber' END ELSE '|ok' END
       WHEN alarm IS NOT NULL AND latest >= alarm THEN '|red' WHEN warn IS NOT NULL AND latest >= warn THEN '|amber' WHEN warn IS NOT NULL THEN '|ok' ELSE '' END END AS "Latest",
 COALESCE(round(av::numeric, dec)::text, '—') AS "⌀ period",
 COALESCE(round(mn::numeric, dec)::text || ' – ' || round(mx::numeric, dec)::text, '—') AS "Range",
 COALESCE(limtxt, CASE WHEN lo IS NOT NULL THEN lo::text || ' – ' || hi::text WHEN warn IS NOT NULL THEN '< ' || warn::text || CASE WHEN alarm IS NOT NULL AND alarm <> warn THEN ' · alarm ' || alarm::text ELSE '' END ELSE '—' END) AS "Limit",
 CASE WHEN (lo IS NULL AND warn IS NULL) OR n = 0 THEN '—' ELSE nout || ' of ' || n || CASE WHEN nout = 0 THEN '|ok' WHEN nout < n / 2.0 THEN '|amber' ELSE '|red' END END AS "Days outside"
FROM q ORDER BY ord

panels.title: Treated wastewater quality · summary

panels.description: One row per parameter, one cell per day, coloured by that parameter's own limit: green within, amber above warning, red above alarm or outside range, blue no limit set, purple impossible value. Tap a cell for its value.

targets.rawSql:
WITH x AS (WITH lim(param, test, ord, unit, dec, warn, alarm, lo, hi, sev, limtxt) AS (VALUES
('Ammonia nitrogen','Ammonia Nitrogen',1,'mg/L',1,5,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber','< 5'),
('Residual chlorine','Free and Residual Chlorine',2,'mg/L',2,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,0.1,0.5,'amber','0.1 – 0.5'),
('Nitrate','Nitrate Nitrogen',3,'mg/L',1,50,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,'amber','< 50'),
('pH','pH',4,'',1,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,6.5,8,'amber-excl','6.5 – 8'),
('SV30 · aeration tank','SV30',5,'mL/L',0,NULL::numeric,NULL::numeric,400,600,'amber','400 – 600')),
d AS (SELECT CASE WHEN btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Aeration%' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume' THEN 'SV30' ELSE btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) END AS test, (l.time_of_sample_collection AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date AS day, avg(l.result) AS v
 FROM user_labtestdata l JOIN user_customform f ON f.id = l.form_id
 WHERE f.team_id = 12 AND (btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Treated Wastewater' OR (btrim(l.location) ILIKE 'Aeration%' AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'Sludge Volume')) AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT lim.param, lim.ord, lim.unit, lim.dec, lim.warn, lim.alarm, lim.lo, lim.hi, lim.sev, lim.limtxt, to_char(d.day,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, d.v FROM lim LEFT JOIN d ON d.test = lim.test ORDER BY lim.ord, d.day) SELECT (day::date)::timestamp AS time, param AS metric, v AS value FROM x WHERE day IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
